description: Comprehensive Test Cases for Prescription Input Validator

testCases.name: Standard Valid Prescription
testCases.description: Valid prescription inputs for both eyes with standard negative diopters and astigmatism.

testCases.name: User Prescription (Valid Individual Fields)
testCases.description: The exact values the user provided: SPH +1.50, CYL -1.00, Axis 105 placed in their respective inputs.

testCases.name: User Pasted Raw Text Into SPH (Empty CYL/Axis)
testCases.description: Reproducing what happens when the entire line 'SPH +1.50, CYL -1.00, Axis 105' is typed into SPH while CYL and Axis are left blank.

expectedErrors.od.sph: Right Eye (OD) SPH must be a valid number
expectedErrors.od.cyl: Right Eye (OD) CYL is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.od.axis: Right Eye (OD) Axis is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.os.sph: Left Eye (OS) SPH must be a valid number
expectedErrors.os.cyl: Left Eye (OS) CYL is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.os.axis: Left Eye (OS) Axis is required. Please enter a value.

testCases.name: Boundary Limits (Min -20/-8/0 and Max +20/+8/180)
testCases.description: Boundary values testing minimum allowable numbers (-20.00 SPH, -8.00 CYL, 0 Axis) and maximum (+20.00 SPH, +8.00 CYL, 180 Axis). Axis 0 must be accepted and NOT treated as missing.

testCases.name: SPH Below Minimum (-25.00)
testCases.description: SPH value outside allowable range of -20.00 to +20.00 D.

expectedErrors.od.sph: Right Eye (OD) SPH must be between -20.00 and +20.00 D

testCases.name: CYL Above Maximum (+10.00)
testCases.description: CYL value exceeding the allowable maximum limit of +8.00 D.

expectedErrors.od.cyl: Right Eye (OD) CYL must be between -8.00 and +8.00 D

expectedErrors.od.axis: Right Eye (OD) Axis must be between 0 and 180°
Right Eye (OD) Axis must be a non-negative whole number between 0 and 180°

testCases.name: Decimal Axis (45.5)
testCases.description: Axis with decimal value, which must be strictly rejected according to whole numbers only rule.

expectedErrors.od.axis: Right Eye (OD) Axis must be a whole number (0 to 180°). Decimal values like "45.5" are not permitted.

testCases.name: Empty Form Submission
testCases.description: All 6 inputs submitted empty. Must reject and show 6 distinct errors without crashing.

expectedErrors.od.sph: Right Eye (OD) SPH is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.od.cyl: Right Eye (OD) CYL is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.od.axis: Right Eye (OD) Axis is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.os.sph: Left Eye (OS) SPH is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.os.cyl: Left Eye (OS) CYL is required. Please enter a value.
expectedErrors.os.axis: Left Eye (OS) Axis is required. Please enter a value.

testCases.name: Non-Numeric String (abc)
testCases.description: Non-numeric alphabetical text entered into SPH.

expectedErrors.os.sph: Left Eye (OS) SPH must be a valid number
